description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Coordinated Takedown. When a creature within reach of your natural weapons is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies, you can use your Reaction to immediately force that creature to make a Strength Saving Throw as per your Fanged Aspect feature.
  • Bolstering Barks. Whenever you use the Help action on one of your allies, they gain temporary hit points equal to half your Shifter level.
  • Fierce Protector. When you hit a creature with your natural weapons, it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against creatures other than you until the end of your next turn while it is within your reach. If it makes an attack against a target other than you during that time, you have Advantage on your next Attack Roll against it and add half your Shifter level to the damage roll (rounded down).
